saw_lines: Buyers pick underwear by fit and feel, reorder the same size for years, so new seasons rarely win the first order.
So the first order is won or lost in the opening line, before a shopper asks about fit, fabric or delivery.
Your 15 ads all open on the same new in line. Name two or three new angles from Holly and Hetti and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 15 of 15 ads open on the same new in line. Shoppers see one story repeated, so the account only ever sells one angle. Run three new angles from your range, lace, bamboo and cashmere, and test each against it.

Your site explains how orders arrive, but 0 of 15 ads mention delivery. A first buyer hesitates without that answer. Film the box reaching a door and cut it into one of your 2 video ads, opening on the delivery.

The same copy runs in 15 of 15 ads so one message reaches your whole audience with nothing to learn from. Keep the copy, and change the opening line and the image in each ad, starting with three new openings.

None of your 15 ads carries a proof number, so a first buyer has nothing concrete to weigh against the price. Collect one real figure, such as orders shipped or a review count, and lead the next batch with it.

ads_1: Lace, bamboo and cashmere openers for Holly and Hetti, tested against the current line
